checklist.question: Do the implemented component boundaries match the frozen component contract without moving benchmark semantics into legacy runtime modules?
Are schema, design, crosswalk, generation, relation, storage and CLI failures attributable and fail closed without fallback or silent repair?
Do planner, evaluator and human-blind projections use allowlists and preserve the frozen leakage boundary?
Do write-new storage, checkpoint progression, explicit resume binding, tamper rejection and terminal checksums satisfy BP5?
Does the CLI expose only the seven frozen offline commands with stable structured exit behavior and no network dependency?
Are tests, hashes, failed attempts, zero-call accounting and the implementation_validated_offline claim boundary recorded accurately?
Does this closure avoid template authoring, real corpus generation, confirmation, E2E, Provider, judge and formal experiment authorization?

instructions: A user or independent human reviewer must decide every checklist item and the overall decision. Machine audit and the implementation author must not infer or approve these decisions.
